messages.subject: Project Lyra — our counter-draft (v3) before it goes back
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Naomi,

Before we send our counter to Birchall Stone, here's where we've landed (tracked, attached as v3):
- Liability (cl. 11.3): IP warranties (9.2-9.6) and confidentiality fully uncapped; general cap at the greater of £10m or sums paid in the prior 12 months — up from their £6m;
- Diligence long-stop (cl. 4.1): pushed to 30 June 2028;
- Audit threshold (cl. 3.7): reverted to 5%.

If you're comfortable I'll send this across today and aim to sign by month end.

Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield | Partner, Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0118
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
